target_policy.rationale: Turbofan wear is physically undetectable during early cruise cycles. Capping the target at 125 cycles concentrates loss minimization on the active maintenance decision window without distorting gradient steps.

security_disclaimer: SHA-256 checksums provide tamper-detection and integrity verification against accidental modification or corruption. When signed with an Ed25519 private key, the manifest cryptographically authenticates model and preprocessor artifacts against unauthorized tampering. Note: The unsigned file is not immutable and SHA-256 alone does not authenticate artifacts against an attacker with local filesystem write access; asymmetric Ed25519 digital signatures enforce cryptographic authentication.
mlflow_evaluation: MLflow was evaluated as an artifact tracking option. For this self-contained NASA C-MAPSS benchmark research prototype, introducing MLflow would add heavy dependencies (sqlite/psycopg2, alembic, greenlet, sqlalchemy, cloudpickle, databricks-sdk), a separate tracking server, and container bloat without runtime benefit. A structured JSON manifest with SHA-256 checksums provides deterministic, zero-overhead artifact integrity verification and provenance tracking for offline and container-native execution. Note: As an unsigned manifest, SHA-256 checksums provide tamper-evidence against accidental corruption, but do not provide cryptographic authentication or immutability against an adversary with filesystem write access (which requires external digital signatures).
